title_zh: DBT 戒煙介入對自殺高風險退伍軍人的先導試驗
title_en: DBT tobacco cessation intervention for veterans at risk for suicide
summary_zh: 68 名每日吸煙的退伍軍人隨機分派至 DBT 戒煙介入或常規治療，兩組均接受 12 週團體治療並追蹤 24 週。兩組戒煙率在治療結束及追蹤期均無差異，但 DBT 組情緒調節有改善趨勢，學員整體滿意。結果顯示自殺高風險人士可安全參與戒煙介入，但 DBT 戒煙的額外效益仍需更大規模研究確認。
summary_en: In a pilot trial, 68 veterans who smoked daily and were at heightened risk for suicide were randomised to a DBT tobacco cessation intervention or treatment as usual, both with 12 weeks of group treatment and 24-week follow-up. Abstinence did not differ between groups at end of treatment or follow-up, but the DBT group showed a trend toward improved emotion regulation and participants were satisfied overall.
evidence_note: 已接受稿（advance article）：隨機先導試驗（n=68）
caution: 先導試驗樣本小；戒煙率兩組無差異，DBT 的額外效益仍需更大規模研究確認。
brief_zh: 68 名自殺高風險吸煙退伍軍人，12 週團體治療
兩組戒煙率在治療結束及 24 週追蹤均無差異
DBT 組情緒調節有改善趨勢
supervision_questions: 自殺高風險人士參與戒煙介入時，安全監察與情緒調節支援如何並行？

posts.title: DBT Tobacco Cessation Intervention for Veterans at Heightened Risk for Suicide: Pilot Trial
posts.content: 先導試驗比較 DBT 戒煙介入與常規治療對自殺高風險吸煙退伍軍人的成效。

evidence_quote: did not differ in terms of abstinence
